Health for all, Hunger for none. This is Bayer’s vision, and in Crop Science Product Supply, we are committed to supporting our farmers’ sustainable production of crops and developing our employees.
Bayer is seeking recent or upcoming graduates to join our team as part of the Rotational Development Program. The program allows you to gain hands-on experience across multiple areas of our Crop Science Product Supply organization. You’ll be able to develop a career path tailored to your interests, development needs, and the needs of the business. After completing the program, your talent, experience, and skills will be matched to an exciting full-time position within our organization.

Operational Excellence Lead

This role leads all Operational Excellence and Capabilities activities, for the CH PS NA Myerstown site. The role leads a dynamic team and is accountable to spearhead the deployment and integration of the PSS (Product Supply System) program and capabilities built across all functions at the Myerstown site. The role is responsible for creating a functional and business vision and strategies to transform the organization from a PSS phase 0 to phase 4 site leading to top decile operational performance within the industry by fostering a culture of continuous improvement, and sustainable excellence. The role requires a strategic mindset, strong leadership capabilities, and a focus on driving innovation, digitalization, and cost efficiency.

This role must provide strong leadership, coaching, and development for high performing teams with a culture based on the Bayer DSO principles. The role ensures the integration of PSS program with overall Factory of the Future site strategies (including automation, smart manufacturing, digitization, and digitally enabled workforce) and associated capabilities built for employees. The incumbent acts as a change agent, collaborating across all site functions to ensure that PSS principles, tools, and methodologies are effectively implemented and embedded into daily operations. The role is accountable for creating measurable value by accelerating the plant’s journey to world-class performance, ensuring that plant performance exceeds benchmark standards in product supply and operational outcomes.

The role embraces Dynamic Shared Ownership (DSO) principles and practices and follows the VACC approach to leadership (being a visionary, architect, catalyst, and coach). The role actively evolves the site operating model and fosters successful adoption of DSO.

YOUR TASKS AND RESPONSIBILITIES

- Team Leadership:  Act as VACC (Visionary, Architect, Coach and Catalyst) to build, lead, and mentor a highperforming team of professionals, promoting a collaborative and innovative work environment. Establish target outcomes, priorities and coordinate talent flow to maximize organizational impact. The incumbent demonstrates, credibly embodies and showcases VACC leadership.

- People Development:

- Shape employee development, evaluation, and career path based on skills; build a diverse, inclusive talent pool where members share and support each other to build their expertise; recruit, hire, and onboard new employees, based on team requirements.

- Establish, coach, and provide vision for site's Operational Excellence and Training functions team fostering collaboration, knowledge sharing, and professional development. Leverage agile work practices supporting the teams to align and adapt resources to highest enterprise priorities. Foster culture of transparency of priorities and metrics empowering every team and employee to take accountability to operate as high performing teams.

- Lead, mentor, and coach the teams, fostering a culture of continuous improvements, learning and acceleration of PSS initiatives including being proactive in providing development experience to talents. Foster a collaborative and positive work environment where employees feel valued and engaged.

- Identify capabilities and upskilling training needs and develop or source training programs to enhance the skills and knowledge of the team. Develop and maintain high performing teams with higher level of self-organization and proactive culture that accentuates continuous improvement principles.

- Team Capability:

- Support teams to learn in rapid cycles and build capabilities needed to create value for customers and other stakeholders

- Strategy Development:

- Collaborate with cross functional team leads and develop a comprehensive site strategy (aka SSR) related to space utilization, new innovative manufacturing technologies, facility layout and expansion, integration with site and global/regional innovation programs, and building resiliency into the plant operating modules leading to a 5+ year site strategy. This strategy will align with the organization's overall business objectives, ensuring scalability, sustainability, and competitive advantage.

- Lead the cross-functional collaboration in development of site KPIs, tools to monitor the site performance and monthly reporting.

- Operational Excellence / PSS Program:

- Ensure the development and execution of robust Operational Excellence, Efficiencies and Continuous Improvement strategies for all functions in alignment with global PSS (Product Supply Systems) program.

- Develop site PSS Phase progression plan with site Pillar Leaders, and site Function Leads, with support from Global OE team including a gap analysis of current capability across the pillars, compare to the next phase pillar requirements, and drive phase progress approach for site.

- Develop and deploy continues improvement programs and processes towards zero loss mindset using LEAN methodologies and coach PSS Pillar leaders to deliver requirements to achieve next phase progression journey step.

- Support development of cross-functional KPIs and digital tools to execute the Level (1, 1.5, 2, 3) collaborations.

- Drive a culture of innovation, continuous improvement and Factory of the Future (digitalization) initiatives to enhance operational efficiency, reduce costs, and increase productivity.

- Provide leadership for cost savings and key strategic initiatives for new technologies across manufacturing, packaging, warehouse, and quality functions at the Myerstown site.

- Set priorities consistent with site, regional and global company goals and focus on high priority opportunities.

- Capabilities Building:

- Responsible for designing, implementing, and sustaining comprehensive learning initiatives across the site to develop skills and adopt a digitally enabled mindset.

- Identify current skill gaps and future needs through robust assessment tools, feedback mechanisms, and data analysis, informing targeted development plans.

- Develop and execute a site-wide training strategy that aligns with organizational goals and prioritizes digital literacy, technology adoption, and future-ready capabilities.

- Create and deliver engaging learning experiences - both in-person and online, including workshops, e-learning modules, and hands-on training focused on digital skills and tools.

- Champion the adoption of a growth mindset and digital-first culture by fostering curiosity, adaptability, and openness to technological change among employees.

- Ensure complete compliance with all federal regulatory agencies’ requirements, in conjunction with other departments ensure that training programs are developed and implemented to meet all Bayer Quality and Health, Environment and Safety standards. Assure compliance to Bayer policies and directives.

- Conduct regular audits and inspections to identify and address any compliance issues. As well as provide the appropriate subject matter experts during FDA and other internal/external agencies audits. with particular emphasis on Operational Excellence and Training processes at the site.

- Cross-Functional Collaboration :

WHO YOU ARE

- Bachelor's degree or master's degree with multi-functional experience in Engineering, Manufacturing, or Operational Excellence/LEAN. 10 years with bachelor's or 8 years with master's degree with leadership/production/supervisory experience in FDA, pharmaceutical industry is preferred.

- Multifunctional and deep experience of complex manufacturing management in the consumer and/or pharmaceutical industry

Preferred Qualifications:

Regional Sales Manager is responsible for delivering commercial targets and sustainable business growth within the assigned territory. Clinical Operations Manager 2 (COM2)

The COM 2 is a regional role that provides expertise across all aspects of clinical site management and/ or study management for assigned Phase I – IV studies. The COM 2 operates in line with Good Clinical Practices (ICH-GCP), applicable regulatory and legal requirements and Bayer’s standard operating procedures.
The COM 2 may be assigned work packages in areas of study start-up, site management and study management on a regional level. Either one or a combination of these work packages may be allocated to the position holder according to expertise, skill set and capacity requirements in a flexible way. The COM 2 must acquire knowledge and adequate training for work packages assigned and become proficient in independently executing assigned responsibilities.

STUDY MANAGEMENT
- Lead and oversee all operational aspects of site management on a regional or study level from protocol feasibility to study archive.
- Serve as the representative for site management on the core study team.
- Contribute to the development of the protocol, study overview, monitoring strategy and Risk Based Quality Management with regards to monitoring and operational aspects.
- Responsible and accountable for developing the monitoring plan and the study-specific training plan.
- Key contributor in the development of recruitment and retention strategies and tools.
- Act as key study contact for assigned countries. Responsible for overall deliverables regarding timelines, budget, and quality in assigned countries.
- Ensure participating country commitment aligns with study commitments.
- Provide the information required to effectively monitor and manage study activities, ensuring all relevant IT systems are updated with precise and current data.
- Oversee monitoring activities and ensure sponsor oversight through monitoring report review and co-monitoring visits.

SITE MANAGEMENT
- Act as primary contact for investigational sites.
- Verify site qualification, ensure the Investigator, and site staff meet all aspects of study delivery and commitments from site selection through close out.
- Train the Investigator and site staff on study protocol, relevant systems and operational aspects of study conduct.
- Monitor trial conduct in compliance with the study protocol, ICH-GCP and applicable regulatory requirements on time and quality. Ensure completeness of the Investigator Site File.
- Prepare and conduct onsite and/or remote monitoring activities according to monitoring plan, including complete reporting and follow up.

CLINICAL CUSTOMER ENGAGEMENT
- Cultivate and sustain customer relations with clinical trial sites, ensure effective communication, drive fit for purpose processes and work towards enhancing overall site satisfaction and engagement.
- Establish and develop strong professional relationships with clinical investigators to expand/ maintain clinical research partnership opportunities.
- Cross functional collaboration to ensure alignment of priorities and deliver the portfolio.
- Influence and challenge internal and external factors to improve clinical research delivery.

STUDY START-UP
- Lead study start-up activities in collaboration with local team.
- Provide input on site activation strategy.
- Collect and perform quality review of essential documents on country level such as IRB/IEC approvals, financial disclosure, CVs/medical licenses, etc.
- Compile and submit submission dossier (country dependent).
- Obtain any required approvals for relevant site documents (e.g., informed consent, financial disclosures).
- Prepare and distribute site start up documentation including Investigator Site File.
- Ensure timely filing of study documents at country and site level in Trial Master File (TMF).
- Ensure awareness of related local regulations and support maintenance of country intelligence.
- Provide study status monitoring and systems support (e.g. act as technical expert)
- Coordinate site and vendor payments.

QUALITY
- Proactively identify and communicate issues, taking appropriate action to prevent the recurrence of identified deviations. Ensure timely and comprehensive resolution of issues that may affectcompliance or the quality of study related activities or data.
- Maintain corrective action and preventative action plans (CAPAs) at country level.
- Contribute to the preparation, conduct, and follow-up of Site Audits and Regulatory Inspections to ensure a successful outcome.
- Oversee completeness of country/site level eTMF and conduct QC for accuracy, completeness, and adherence to ICH/GCP and Bayer QSDs.

Healthcare related Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent with minimum 4 years of monitoring and site management experience. Or have a combination of education and minimum 8 years of monitoring and site management experience. Experience in Spain.
